messages:
julie_support: Customer reported missing role_change events during the 03/18 02:10-02:25 UTC surge. They saw 200s but no docs in workspace index. Anyone tracking ingest?
anna_security: Pinging infra + SRE. Any KMS rotations or RBAC schema work around then?
raj_infra: We saw queue depth on audit-index consumers spike x4 02:10-02:22 UTC, ES refresh latency increased, backpressure kicked in and non-critical transforms were dropped.
kevin_sre: Ingest lat P95->P99 spiked. Our batcher auto-scaled to larger batches to maintain throughput which increased downstream pressure.
marta_prod: Did schema validation reject a batch? We pushed RBAC schema tweak last week (role_metadata optional).
julie_support: Customer reported mixed client responses (5xx/429/200) on retries, but role_change type missing entirely.
raj_infra: Logs show ~1.2% validation.error: schema_mismatch from malformed role_id. Not enough to explain entire missing event type.
liam_eng: Important: when KMS decrypt fails we mark payloads redacted and the mapper drops event_type for redacted payloads. If KMS errors rose during the surge that could hide types.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: ALERT audit-processor pool scaled to 0/10 for ~90s due to OOM in msgpack decoder workers; instances restarted.
kevin_sre: OOM + autoscale cooldown + ES backpressure = message shedding. That would drop events permanently if not durably stored.
anna_security: Proposed mitigations:
- Preflight validation endpoint for customers (schema + KMS check) (marta)
- Short-term WAL to durable storage for high-backpressure windows (raj)
- Change ingest ack strategy: immediate small ack + async durable write + replay path (kevin)
- Require schema_version header to avoid silent incompatible changes (marta)
- Fuzz tests for msgpack decoder and review dependency bump (anna)
marta_prod: Preflight API idea: POST /v1/audit/validate returns OK|errors, checks schema, sample KMS decrypt, and reports issues. Low lift and helpful for customers.
raj_infra: Short-term infra steps:
- Never drop authoritative fields on shed; only shed optional transforms
- Fast-ack + WAL to S3 for replay
- Cold-indexing path to apply WAL during recovery
Long-term: consumer decoupling, QoS tiers, and append-only index mappings.
liam_eng: Append-only mapping + replay reduces reindex cost. WAL costs estimated ~ $1.2k/mo at current 99p arrival; will produce a short trade-off doc.
julie_support: Offering customer: preflight + 48h raw-batch retention for affected workspace, and a status note. Also consider temporary credits if SLA affected.
kevin_sre: Runbook PR to add ingest-burst play. Snippet for ingest tuning:
```
# ingest tuning
batch.max_items: 50
batch.max_time_ms: 120
ack_strategy: immediate_then_async
shed_policy: drop_best_effort_only
```
kevin_sre: Will add quick rollback commands and an es-priority script for index recovery; will run staging smoke tests before enabling.
anna_security: Owners: raj_infra (WAL + queue), liam_eng (mapping + cost), marta_prod (preflight + schema policy), kevin_sre (runbook + ops), julie_support (customer comms), anna_security (KMS + vuln triage).
julie_support: I'll draft customer note and timeline. Will loop in legal for any SLA language.
anna_security: Also action: patch msgpack dep + add fuzz/crash tests to prevent OOM from malformed input.
liam_eng: On KMS strategy: decrypt-on-ingest gives immediate typed docs but costs CPU/KMS calls; decrypt-on-index saves CPU during surge but stores encrypted payloads longer in WAL.
raj_infra: Short-lived flag idea: enable WAL + async-ack during detected backpressure windows automatically.
kevin_sre: Agreed. We'll prioritize minimal-impact quick wins: preflight endpoint, WAL prototype, runbook. Follow-up meeting in 30m.
julie_support: :thumbsup: Posting customer update now, will add follow-ups here.
